 pub fn parse_descriptor(raw: &str, label: &str) -> Result<ProviderDescriptor> {
-    toml::from_str(raw).map_err(|source| ProviderError::Toml {
-        path: label.to_string(),
-        source,
-    })
+    let descriptor: ProviderDescriptor =
+        toml::from_str(raw).map_err(|source| ProviderError::Toml {
+            path: label.to_string(),
+            source,
+        })?;
+    // A catalog with zero or several recommended entries gives pickers no
+    // honest default; fail closed at parse time like other descriptor
+    // validation. Catalogs are optional, but once present exactly one entry
+    // is the recommendation.
+    if !descriptor.model_catalog.is_empty() {
+        let recommended = descriptor
+            .model_catalog
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|entry| entry.recommended)
+            .count();
+        if recommended > 1 {
+            return Err(ProviderError::InvalidConfig(format!(
+                "{label}: model catalog marks {recommended} entries recommended; exactly one is allowed"
+            )));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(descriptor)
 }
 
 pub fn parse_custom_command(command: &str) -> Result<(String, Vec<String>)> {

+#[cfg(test)]
+mod model_catalog_tests {
+    use super::ProviderRegistry;
+
+    #[test]
+    fn every_builtin_descriptor_has_a_populated_model_catalog() {
+        let registry = ProviderRegistry::builtin().expect("builtin registry");
+        for descriptor in registry.iter() {
+            if descriptor.id == "smoke" {
+                continue; // the scripted test provider has no model space
+            }
+            assert!(
+                descriptor.model_catalog.len() >= 2,
+                "{} must catalog real models beyond 'provider default' (has {})",
+                descriptor.id,
+                descriptor.model_catalog.len()
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn every_builtin_descriptor_has_exactly_one_recommended_model() {
+        let registry = ProviderRegistry::builtin().expect("builtin registry");
+        for descriptor in registry.iter() {
+            if descriptor.id == "smoke" {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let recommended = descriptor
+                .model_catalog
+                .iter()
+                .filter(|entry| entry.recommended)
+                .count();
+            assert_eq!(
+                recommended, 1,
+                "{} must mark exactly one recommended model",
+                descriptor.id
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn model_entry_without_recommended_field_still_parses() {
+        // Pre-rider descriptor TOML omits `recommended`; it must default off.
+        let raw = r#"
+id = "fixture"
+display_name = "Fixture"
+kind = "cli"
+default_binary = "fixture"
+
+[[model_catalog]]
+id = "provider default"
+context_window = 1000
+"#;
+        let descriptor = super::parse_descriptor(raw, "fixture-test").expect("parse");
+        assert_eq!(descriptor.model_catalog.len(), 1);
+        assert!(!descriptor.model_catalog[0].recommended);
+    }
+}

148	
149	impl ModelCatalogOverride {
150	    pub fn from_value(value: JsonValue) -> Result<Self> {
151	        #[derive(Deserialize)]
152	        #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
153	        struct CatalogResponse {
154	            models: Vec<ModelEntry>,
155	        }
156	
157	        let response: CatalogResponse = serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|source| {
158	            ProviderError::InvalidConfig(format!(
159	                "catalog seam response must be {{\"models\": [...]}}: {source}"
160	            ))
161	        })?;
162	        Self::from_models(response.models)
163	    }
164	
165	    pub fn from_models(models: Vec<ModelEntry>) -> Result<Self> {
166	        if models.is_empty() {
167	            return Err(ProviderError::InvalidConfig(
168	                "catalog seam response must include at least one model".to_string(),
169	            ));
170	        }
171	        let mut entries = BTreeMap::new();
172	        for model in models {
173	            if model.id.trim().is_empty() {
174	                return Err(ProviderError::InvalidConfig(
175	                    "catalog seam model id must not be empty".to_string(),
176	                ));
177	            }
178	            entries.insert(model.id.clone(), model.clone());
179	            for alias in &model.aliases {
180	                if !alias.trim().is_empty() {
181	                    entries.insert(alias.clone(), model.clone());
182	                }
183	            }
184	        }
185	        Ok(Self { entries })
186	    }
187	
188	    pub fn entry_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Option<&ModelEntry> {
189	        self.entries.get(model)
190	    }
191	}

315	impl ProviderRegistry {
316	    pub fn builtin() -> Result<Self> {
317	        let mut registry = Self::default();
318	        for (id, raw) in BUILTIN_DESCRIPTOR_SOURCES {
319	            let descriptor = parse_descriptor(raw, &format!("builtin:{id}"))?;
320	            registry
321	                .descriptors
322	                .insert(descriptor.id.clone(), descriptor);
323	        }
324	        Ok(registry)
325	    }
326	
327	    pub fn with_overrides(home: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
328	        let mut registry = Self::builtin()?;
329	        let overrides_dir = home.join("providers.d");
330	        let mut paths = match fs::read_dir(&overrides_dir) {
331	            Ok(entries) => entries
332	                .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
333	                .map(|entry| entry.path())
334	                .filter(|path| path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) == Some("toml"))
335	                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
336	            Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(registry),
337	            Err(source) => {
338	                return Err(ProviderError::Io {
339	                    path: overrides_dir.display().to_string(),
340	                    source,
341	                });
342	            }
343	        };
344	        paths.sort();
345	        for path in paths {
346	            registry.load_override(&path)?;
347	        }
348	        Ok(registry)
349	    }
350	
351	    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&ProviderDescriptor> {
352	        self.descriptors.get(id)
353	    }
354	
355	    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &ProviderDescriptor> {
356	        self.descriptors.values()
357	    }
358	
359	    pub fn ids(&self) -> Vec<String> {
360	        self.descriptors.keys().cloned().collect()
361	    }
362	
363	    pub async fn probe_all(&self, options: ProviderProbeOptions) -> Vec<ProviderProbeResult> {
364	        let mut results = Vec::new();
365	        for descriptor in self.iter() {
366	            results.push(descriptor.probe(options).await);
367	        }
368	        results
369	    }
370	
371	    fn load_override(&mut self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
372	        let raw = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|source| ProviderError::Io {
373	            path: path.display().to_string(),
374	            source,
375	        })?;
376	        let mut override_value = parse_toml_value(&raw, path)?;
377	        let id = descriptor_id_from_value(&override_value)
378	            .or_else(|| id_from_path(path))
379	            .ok_or_else(|| {
380	                ProviderError::InvalidConfig(format!(
381	                    "provider override {} must include id",
382	                    path.display()
383	                ))
384	            })?;
385	        ensure_id(&mut override_value, &id)?;
386	        let merged = if let Some(existing) = self.descriptors.get(&id) {
387	            let mut base = descriptor_to_value(existing)?;
388	            merge_values(&mut base, override_value);
389	            base
390	        } else {
391	            override_value
392	        };
393	        let descriptor = value_to_descriptor(merged, path)?;
394	        self.descriptors.insert(descriptor.id.clone(), descriptor);
395	        Ok(())
396	    }
397	}
398	
399	pub fn parse_descriptor(raw: &str, label: &str) -> Result<ProviderDescriptor> {
400	    let descriptor: ProviderDescriptor =
401	        toml::from_str(raw).map_err(|source| ProviderError::Toml {
402	            path: label.to_string(),
403	            source,
404	        })?;
405	    // A catalog with zero or several recommended entries gives pickers no
406	    // honest default; fail closed at parse time like other descriptor
407	    // validation. Catalogs are optional, but once present exactly one entry
408	    // is the recommendation.
409	    if !descriptor.model_catalog.is_empty() {
410	        let recommended = descriptor
411	            .model_catalog
412	            .iter()
413	            .filter(|entry| entry.recommended)
414	            .count();
415	        if recommended > 1 {
416	            return Err(ProviderError::InvalidConfig(format!(
417	                "{label}: model catalog marks {recommended} entries recommended; exactly one is allowed"
418	            )));
419	        }
420	    }
421	    Ok(descriptor)
422	}
423	
424	pub fn parse_custom_command(command: &str) -> Result<(String, Vec<String>)> {
425	    let args = split_command_line(command);
426	    let Some((binary, rest)) = args.split_first() else {
427	        return Err(ProviderError::InvalidConfig(
428	            "custom provider command cannot be empty".to_string(),
429	        ));
430	    };
431	    Ok((binary.clone(), rest.to_vec()))
432	}

434	impl ProviderProbe for ProviderDescriptor {
435	    fn probe<'a>(&'a self, options: ProviderProbeOptions) -> ProviderProbeFuture<'a> {
436	        Box::pin(async move { probe_descriptor(self, options).await })
437	    }
438	}
439	
440	async fn probe_descriptor(
441	    descriptor: &ProviderDescriptor,
442	    options: ProviderProbeOptions,
443	) -> ProviderProbeResult {
444	    match descriptor.kind {
445	        DescriptorKind::Cli => probe_cli_descriptor(descriptor),
446	        DescriptorKind::Http => probe_http_descriptor(descriptor, options).await,
447	        DescriptorKind::LocalHttp => probe_local_http_descriptor(descriptor, options).await,
448	        DescriptorKind::Scripted => base_probe_result(

452	            None,

455	            None,

460	fn probe_cli_descriptor(descriptor: &ProviderDescriptor) -> ProviderProbeResult {
461	    let Some(binary) = descriptor.default_binary.as_deref() else {
462	        return base_probe_result(
463	            descriptor,
464	            ProbeStatus::Failed,
465	            None,
466	            None,
467	            "missing",
468	            Some(ProbeErrorKind::NotFound),
469	            Some("no default binary configured".to_string()),
470	        );
471	    };
472	    let Some(location) = resolve_binary(binary) else {
473	        return base_probe_result(
474	            descriptor,
475	            ProbeStatus::Failed,
476	            Some(binary.to_string()),
477	            None,
478	            "missing",
479	            Some(ProbeErrorKind::NotFound),
480	            Some(format!("{binary} not on PATH")),
481	        );
482	    };
483	    if let Some(probe) = descriptor.version_probe.as_ref()
484	        && !probe.args.is_empty()
485	    {
486	        match Command::new(&location).args(&probe.args).output() {
487	            Ok(output) => {
488	                if !output.status.success() {
489	                    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
490	                    return base_probe_result(
491	                        descriptor,
492	                        ProbeStatus::Failed,
493	                        Some(location.display().to_string()),
494	                        None,
495	                        "missing",
496	                        Some(ProbeErrorKind::ProbeFailed),
497	                        Some(trim_probe_message(&stderr)),
498	                    );
499	                }
500	                let version = trim_probe_message(&format!(
501	                    "{}{}",
502	                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
503	                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
504	                ));
505	                if let Some(expected) = probe.expect_substring.as_deref()
506	                    && !version.contains(expected)
507	                {
508	                    return base_probe_result(
509	                        descriptor,
510	                        ProbeStatus::Failed,
511	                        Some(location.display().to_string()),
512	                        Some(version),
513	                        "missing",
514	                        Some(ProbeErrorKind::VersionMismatch),
515	                        Some(format!("version output did not contain {expected}")),
516	                    );
517	                }
518	                if let Some(min) = probe.min_known_good.as_deref()
519	                    && !version_at_least(&version, min)
520	                {
521	                    return base_probe_result(
522	                        descriptor,
523	                        ProbeStatus::Failed,
524	                        Some(location.display().to_string()),
525	                        Some(version),
526	                        "missing",
527	                        Some(ProbeErrorKind::VersionMismatch),
528	                        Some(format!("version below known-good {min}")),
529	                    );
530	                }
531	                return base_probe_result(
532	                    descriptor,
533	                    ProbeStatus::Ok,
534	                    Some(location.display().to_string()),
535	                    Some(version),
536	                    "ready",
537	                    None,
538	                    None,
539	                );
540	            }
541	            Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied => {
542	                return base_probe_result(
543	                    descriptor,
544	                    ProbeStatus::Failed,
545	                    Some(location.display().to_string()),
546	                    None,
547	                    "missing",
548	                    Some(ProbeErrorKind::PermissionDenied),
549	                    Some(format!("permission denied running {binary}")),
550	                );
551	            }
552	            Err(source) => {
553	                return base_probe_result(
554	                    descriptor,
555	                    ProbeStatus::Failed,
556	                    Some(location.display().to_string()),
557	                    None,
558	                    "missing",
559	                    Some(ProbeErrorKind::ProbeFailed),
560	                    Some(source.to_string()),
561	                );
562	            }
563	        }
564	    }
565	    base_probe_result(
566	        descriptor,
567	        ProbeStatus::Ok,
568	        Some(location.display().to_string()),
569	        None,
570	        "ready",
571	        None,
572	        None,
573	    )
574	}

576	async fn probe_http_descriptor(
577	    descriptor: &ProviderDescriptor,
578	    options: ProviderProbeOptions,
579	) -> ProviderProbeResult {
580	    if let AuthKind::ApiKey = descriptor.auth.kind {
581	        let Some(env_var) = descriptor.auth.env_var.as_deref() else {
582	            return base_probe_result(
583	                descriptor,
584	                ProbeStatus::Failed,
585	                descriptor.default_endpoint.clone(),
586	                None,
587	                "missing",
588	                Some(ProbeErrorKind::AuthMissing),
589	                Some("api-key provider has no env var configured".to_string()),
590	            );
591	        };
592	        if std::env::var(env_var)
593	            .ok()
594	            .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
595	            .is_none()
596	        {
597	            return base_probe_result(
598	                descriptor,
599	                ProbeStatus::Failed,
600	                descriptor.default_endpoint.clone(),
601	                None,
602	                "missing",
603	                Some(ProbeErrorKind::AuthMissing),
604	                Some(format!("{env_var} missing")),
605	            );
606	        }
607	    }
608	    if options.ping {
609	        return ping_endpoint(descriptor).await;
610	    }
611	    base_probe_result(
612	        descriptor,
613	        ProbeStatus::Ok,
614	        descriptor.default_endpoint.clone(),
615	        Some("ping skipped".to_string()),
616	        "ready",
617	        None,
618	        None,
619	    )
620	}

628	    }

632	        descriptor.default_endpoint.clone(),

640	async fn ping_endpoint(descriptor: &ProviderDescriptor) -> ProviderProbeResult {
641	    let endpoint = descriptor.default_endpoint.clone().unwrap_or_default();
642	    let client = match reqwest::Client::builder()
643	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(2))
644	        .build()
645	    {
646	        Ok(client) => client,
647	        Err(source) => {
648	            return base_probe_result(
649	                descriptor,
650	                ProbeStatus::Failed,
651	                Some(endpoint),
652	                None,
653	                "missing",
654	                Some(ProbeErrorKind::ProbeFailed),
655	                Some(source.to_string()),
656	            );
657	        }
658	    };
659	    match client.get(&endpoint).send().await {
660	        Ok(response) => base_probe_result(
661	            descriptor,
662	            ProbeStatus::Ok,
663	            Some(endpoint),
664	            Some(format!("HTTP {}", response.status())),
665	            "ready",
666	            None,
667	            None,
668	        ),
669	        Err(source) => base_probe_result(
670	            descriptor,
671	            ProbeStatus::Failed,
672	            Some(endpoint),
673	            None,
674	            "missing",
675	            Some(ProbeErrorKind::EndpointUnreachable),
676	            Some(source.to_string()),
677	        ),
678	    }
679	}

715	fn resolve_binary(binary: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
716	    let configured = PathBuf::from(binary);
717	    if configured.components().count() > 1 || configured.is_absolute() {
718	        return configured.exists().then_some(configured);
719	    }
720	    which::which(binary).ok()
721	}
722	
723	fn expand_home_path(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
724	    let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("HOME").map(PathBuf::from) else {
725	        return path.to_path_buf();
726	    };
727	    if path == Path::new("~") {
728	        return home;
729	    }
730	    if let Ok(rest) = path.strip_prefix("~") {
731	        return home.join(rest);
732	    }
733	    path.to_path_buf()
734	}
735	
736	fn trim_probe_message(message: &str) -> String {
737	    let first_line = message
738	        .lines()
739	        .find(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
740	        .unwrap_or("");
741	    let trimmed = first_line.trim();
742	    if trimmed.len() > 120 {
743	        format!("{}...", &trimmed[..120])
744	    } else {
745	        trimmed.to_string()
746	    }
747	}
748	
749	fn version_at_least(output: &str, minimum: &str) -> bool {
750	    let observed = first_version_tuple(output);
751	    let required = first_version_tuple(minimum);
752	    if observed.is_empty() || required.is_empty() {
753	        return output >= minimum;
754	    }
755	    compare_version_tuples(&observed, &required) != std::cmp::Ordering::Less
756	}
757	
758	fn first_version_tuple(text: &str) -> Vec<u64> {
759	    text.split(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_digit() && ch != '.')
760	        .find(|part| part.chars().any(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()))
761	        .unwrap_or("")
762	        .split('.')
763	        .filter_map(|part| part.parse::<u64>().ok())
764	        .collect()
765	}
766	
767	fn compare_version_tuples(left: &[u64], right: &[u64]) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
768	    let len = left.len().max(right.len());
769	    for index in 0..len {
770	        let l = left.get(index).copied().unwrap_or(0);
771	        let r = right.get(index).copied().unwrap_or(0);
772	        match l.cmp(&r) {
773	            std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => {}
774	            ordering => return ordering,
775	        }
776	    }
777	    std::cmp::Ordering::Equal
778	}
779	
780	fn split_command_line(command: &str) -> Vec<String> {
781	    let mut args = Vec::new();
782	    let mut current = String::new();
783	    let mut quote = None::<char>;
784	    let mut escaped = false;
785	    for ch in command.chars() {
786	        if escaped {
787	            current.push(ch);
788	            escaped = false;
789	            continue;
790	        }
791	        if ch == '\\' {
792	            escaped = true;
793	            continue;
794	        }
795	        if let Some(active_quote) = quote {
796	            if ch == active_quote {
797	                quote = None;
798	            } else {
799	                current.push(ch);
800	            }
801	            continue;
802	        }
803	        match ch {
804	            '"' | '\'' => quote = Some(ch),
805	            ' ' | '\t' | '\n' => {
806	                if !current.is_empty() {
807	                    args.push(current.clone());
808	                    current.clear();
809	                }
810	            }
811	            _ => current.push(ch),
812	        }
813	    }
814	    if !current.is_empty() {
815	        args.push(current);
816	    }
817	    args
818	}

864	fn merge_values(base: &mut Value, override_value: Value) {
865	    match (base, override_value) {
866	        (Value::Table(base_table), Value::Table(override_table)) => {
867	            for (key, value) in override_table {
868	                match base_table.get_mut(&key) {
869	                    Some(base_value) => merge_values(base_value, value),
870	                    None => {
871	                        base_table.insert(key, value);
872	                    }
873	                }
874	            }
875	        }
876	        (base_value, override_value) => *base_value = override_value,
877	    }
878	}
